aiResearchSummary.text: Kinter is engaged in research and development of retail display hardware, focusing on innovations such as a label protection rail with a universal slot pattern. This device features a mounting portion for attachment to shelving units, a base portion, and a shield portion designed to extend in front of the shelf edge, enhancing protection and functionality for retail shelving systems. These activities highlight Kinter’s focus on improving retail display hardware solutions.
